attr.title: Cuphead
attr.desc: A classic run and gun action game heavily focused on boss battles, inspired by 1930s cartoons.
attr.inst: Requires Cuphead for macOS from GOG (1.3.4, with or without The Delicious Last Course): copy the installed Cuphead.app or GOG's macOS installers (.pkg) into ports/cuphead/gamedata. The first launch builds the game on the device (downloads Unity's Android player from Unity, about 190 MB; one to a few hours; about 10 GB free space needed during setup). Firmwares without 32-bit support get a 64-bit build, whose setup also compiles the game's code (longer; about 12 GB free).
